description: List all hosted apps in your VibeKit account, each with its id, subdomain, status, and live URL. Start here to get an appId for the other app tools.
name: vibekit_list_apps

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of hosted apps, each with id, subdomain, status, and live URL.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit List Apps
